tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rgyu la khams 'dus pa me tog gi phreng ldan bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rgyas byed pad+mo'i tshal ltar yid 'ong sku/ /kun mkhyen lha dang mi yis zhabs mchod pa/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi dpal ldan bsam yas pas/ /blo gsal skye bo'i snyan du tshig 'ga' zhu/ /deng sang kha cig bdag la 'di skad du/ /mthun 'jug mi shes nor med blo sna thung*/ /gcig tu mi tshugs khams 'dus che zhes smra/ /de dag kun gyi lan gcig bshad kyis nyon/ /dam pas dmad cing chos min sdig spyod 'phel/ /g.yo sgyu khram zog pha rol bslu ba'i gzhi/ /'chi kar 'gyod cing phyi ma ngan song rgyu/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug 'di nyid med kyang legs/ /'khor ba'i zhags pa 'dod yon dam pas dmad/ /kun dang rtsod bcas sdug bsngal du ma'i gzhi/ /yod kyang chog shes ma mchis sred pa 'phel/ /ngan song rgyu byed 'byor pas dben kyang legs/ /'jig rten chos la yid 'byung ma skyes na/ /nam yang srid pa'i mtsho las thar ba med/ /mi rtag snying po med pa'i chos rnams la/ /zhen chags mi ldan blo sna thung na legs/ /gcig tu gnas tshe chags sdang ngang gis 'phel/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi bya byed lhag par mang*/ /bdag 'dzin sred pa'i zhags pas 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /de 'dra'i gnas la nges pa med kyang legs/ /khams 'dus 'di yang rgyu med ma yin te/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bdag gis legs bsam pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skye shi'i rba klong can/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul ba'i rang bzhin 'dir 'khyams te/ /thar dka' srid pa mtsho yi gting mthong nas/ /yi chad mchi ma shor te khams 'di 'dus/ /gzhan gyi spyod pa kun tu brtags pas kyang*/ /bdag gi khams 'di 'dus pa'i tshul 'di nyon/ / mchod 'os mkhan slob bla mar khas 'che yang*/ / chos lam mi gnyer 'dod yon 'du 'dzi gnyer/ /phyi rol zhi yang nang na rlom sems che/ /g.yo sgyu tshul 'chos mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /chos ldan pas kyang nor ldan can la gzigs/ /drang po bas kyang g.yon can 'khor la

byams/ /'jig rten chos brgyad don gnyer mi chos mkhan/ /bla ma'i gzugs brnyan mthong bas khams 'di 'dus/ /don ldan mi shes dbyen bcug phra ma mkhan/ /drang por mi gnas g.yon can kha gsags can/ /legs na mi dga' mthun gnyis so sor 'byed/ /de 'dra'i grogs po mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /rang la mi bzod gzhan la rtsol phod can/ /dgos dus mi phan gzhung ngan gzhan phyogs 'dzin/ /cung zad re la rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston/ /de 'dra'i grogs po mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /go rim mi ldan bslab na tshig rtsub 'byin/ /ma dad ma gus gyong bo shing glag can/ /zas la 'jug cing 'bad pa'i las la byol/ /de 'dra'i slob ma mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /dngos su bstod na lkog tu skyon rnams smra/ /chos lam mi gnyer 'dod yon rjes su 'brangs/ /bskyangs pa'i tha mar lan du 'khon bgyis can/ /de 'dra'i slob ma mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /zas gos dman na mkhas kyang 'og tu 'dor/ / nor gyis 'byor na blun yang gong du bkur/ /ngan g.yo can la 'grogs rung rgod por brtsi/ /de 'dra'i skye bo mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /drang por gnas na rab tu gyong par mthong*/ /nor gyis dben na bsod nams med par 'dzin/ / chos dang ldan na 'khos med thabs rdug zer/ /de 'dra'i skye bo mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /mthun 'jug mkhan la dge bshes bzang por brtsi/ /g.yon can tshul 'chos mkhan la btsun par smra/ /tshig rtsub glen zog mkhan la bzang por brtsi/ /de 'dra'i skye bo mthong nas khams 'di 'dus/ /kha len sbyin res bsod nams byas par bsngo/ /gnod 'tshe'i sbyin par dge ba byas par rlom/ /chos min spyad nas bde 'gro thob tu re/ /rnam gzhag phyin ci log 'dis khams 'di 'dus/ / chos med cung zad 'byor na skyid par brtsi/ /sdom brtson nor med mthong na kun gyis brnyas/ /dam pa bas kyang blun po brin pa'i dus/

/khams shig yod na 'di la 'du bar rigs/ /deng sang dus 'dir rnam gzhag phyin ci log /rang skyon dang 'gal yon tan skyon du brtsi/ /tsu ta'i skye bos rkang gnyis mi rnams la/ /rkang gcig lhag ces bzhad gad byed pa ltar/ /rtsom 'chad rtsod par smra ba'i bsam yas pa/ /chos bzhin spyod la brnyas pa dus 'dir mthong*/ /don 'di brjod tshe 'chal rmongs blun po'i tshogs/ /thos bsam grub mtha'i tshul la rab rmongs shing*/ /bslab gsum rin chen mchog nyams glen zog mkhan/ /mtho 'grogs gsar ngas can rnams ma mnyes kyang*/ /tshul khrims lus bzang bslab gsum 'dab gshog rgyas/ /drang po'i mkhar rgyu rnam dpyod bzang po'i tshogs/ /yid la dga' ba bskyed phyir bsdebs pa yin/ / bden rdzun don la gzigs shig blo gsal kun/ /tshul 'di gangs ri'i khrod kyi snyan ngag mkhan/ /tshul khrims blo gros bzang po bdag gis sbyar/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /byang chub snying po'i shing dbang drung 'dug ste/ /mi snyan smra ba'i bdud sde pham byas nas/ /sku gsum lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por shog /'dun pas smra ba yang dag pa'i lan gyis tshar bcad pa'i rab tu byed pa phreng ldan zhes bya ba mang du thos pa'i snyan ngag mkhan dpal ldan bsam yas pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis yongs su sbyar ba rdzogs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) rgyu la khams 'dus pa me tog gi phreng ldan/ -PAGE 314--PAGE 315--PAGE 312-
